body: Visionaries in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for WMS

Whether you are involved in the postal business, delivering express parcels, transporting large cargo or doing third-party and warehouse logistics – we understand your business and how to drive digital innovation there.
The collaboration between Puma and Logistics Reply evolves the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and improves the user experience in daily logistics activities.
The Quality Group relies on Logistics Reply's LEA Reply warehouse management system to expand its supply chain processes in the long term.
We have helped Fabric, a company specialising in automated micro-fulfillment, to bring its robotics capabilities to the highest levels in terms of flexibility and automation.
With Logistics Reply’s partnership, Uniserve faces successfully the challenges of a growing need for scalability and efficiency.
A data-driven business and technology trend report on supply chain digitization, sustainable logistics, workforce transformation and omnichannel distribution.
We virtualize your assets and make them more flexible and reusable for an end-to-end digital journey
We apply artificial intelligence and machine learning to manage complexity both internally and externally with your customers, suppliers and partners
We can drive innovation with you in Marketing, Sales, Operation, HR, and finance
We use digital social listening to help understand global trends and individual markets
We are proud to announce that Logistics Reply has been acknowledged as a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Warehouse Management Systems for the seventh consecutive year.
The Fraunhofer Institute for Material Flow and Logistics (IML) has validated Logistics Reply’s warehouse management system (WMS) LEA Reply™ for the sixth consecutive time in 2025.
Reply has been named a Visionary for the sixth consecutive year in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Warehouse Management Systems.
